title: Minimal task-specific tuning for constituency parsing
description: When applying the Transformer to English constituency parsing, the authors performed only a small number of experiments to select dropout rates, learning rate, and beam size; all other parameters remained unchanged from the English-to-German base translation model. This limited hyperparameter search means the reported parsing results may not reflect the model's full potential on that task.
canonical_description: limited hyperparameter tuning when applying model to new task beyond original training setup

evidence.anchor: performed only a small number of experiments to select
evidence.quote: We performed only a small number of experiments to select the dropout, both attention and residual (section~[REF:sec:reg]), learning rates and beam size on the Section 22 development set, all other parameters remained unchanged from the English-to-German base translation model.
